chunks: They said: "O Hud, you have come to us with no proofs. We shall not abandon our gods because you say so, nor believe in you."
ai.seo_question: Why did the people of Hud reject Prophet Hud's message?
ai.summary: This verse encapsulates the core stance of the disbelievers who demanded empirical 'clear proof' (bayyinah) while simultaneously rejecting the authority of the prophet's word alone, highlighting a common theological tension in Shia exegesis between rational evidence and divine testimony. Their refusal to abandon their ancestral idols underscores the persistence of tradition over truth, a theme frequently cited by scholars to illustrate the obstinacy of those who prioritize cultural heritage over spiritual guidance.
